summaries.ko: 국조특위가 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사하기 위해 오늘 중앙선관위와 서울선관위를 찾아 최초 인지 시점과 보고·의사결정 체계 등을 현장 조사한다.
summaries.en: The special parliamentary investigation committee probing the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections is conducting an on-site inspection today at the Central Election Management Committee and the Seoul Election Management Committee to examine the initial awareness of the shortage and subsequent reporting and decision-making processes.
summaries.zh: 为调查6·3地方选举投票纸短缺事件，国会调查特委今天将前往中央选举管理委员会和首尔市选举管理委员会进行现场调查，以核实最初认知时间及报告和决策体系。
